cleanup.barriers: Floating sargassum barriers deployed by Mexican Navy (SEMAR) and state along exposed Caribbean stretches; north Gulf-facing shore rarely needs them.
cleanup.cleanup: SEMAR sargassum-collection vessels offshore; ZOFEMAT municipal crews on public beaches.
cleanup.resort: Large resorts run their own barrier/rake crews at dawn.

safety.advisory: US State Dept: Quintana Roo, Level 2 (exercise increased caution)
notes: Caribbean-facing Hotel Zone beaches have strong surf; north-facing Playa Norte/Gulf side calmer.
Use authorized taxis; stay in tourist zones at night.
